evidenceBasis.definition: No supplied source, method, sample, or observable basis supports the claim or recommendation.
The user supplied a proof note or assertion, but method, sample, source, and limitations are not all recorded.
A registered source or evidence record supports the point within its stated limitations.
A structured inference from configured principles, rubric anchors, or observable text properties.
Simulated reader feedback from configured audience lenses; this is not market evidence or user research.
Synthetic documentation-task observations used to verify workflow behavior; this is not user evidence, market evidence, or performance proof.
A local deterministic or manual validation result has been recorded for the exact artifact.
A small, documented target-user test supports the point directionally within its sample limits.
Mapped real-user evidence supports the exact claim, audience, channel, and context.
A documented qualified expert review applies to the exact sensitive-domain or compliance question.

findingConfidence.definition: The issue is plausible but weakly supported, subjective, or dependent on missing context.
The issue is reasonably supported by the brief, rubric, or source evidence but needs validation before action.
The issue is directly observable in the text, such as missing CTA, long sentence, superlative, or quantified claim.
The issue is supported by a registered source or evidence record that applies to this context.
The artifact touches a restricted domain or purpose and cannot be treated as ready until the required review is recorded.

recommendationState.definition: The recommendation depends on unsupported claims or proof and must not be treated as publish-ready.
The recommendation touches a disallowed or restricted purpose and is blocked until the ethical or expert-review gate clears.
The recommendation needs domain-specific evidence before it can move forward.
The recommendation is a hypothesis that must be checked with target users.
The recommendation touches a restricted domain where copy quality is not enough to determine safety or compliance.
The recommendation is grounded enough to test but not validated.
The recommendation is suitable for a small, explicit validation test in the exact target context.
The recommendation passed local deterministic or manual validation but still is not market proof.
The recommendation is directionally supported by a documented small user test.
The recommendation is supported by mapped real-user data or expert review for the exact claim, audience, channel, and context.

validationRules.message: Synthetic reader stress tests cannot produce validated_for_exact_context.

validationRules.condition: sensitiveDomainFlags is not empty AND expertReviewStatus != completed AND recommendationState not in [blocked_sensitive_domain, needs_expert_review]
validationRules.message: Sensitive domains cannot exceed needs_expert_review until expert review is recorded.

validationRules.condition: proofAvailable is free text AND evidence record lacks method, sample, sourceId, or limitations AND evidenceBasis != user_provided_unverified
validationRules.message: Free-text proof without method, sample, source, and limitations must default to user_provided_unverified.
Deterministic high confidence is allowed only for observable text properties.
Real user data applies only to the exact mapped claim, audience, channel, and context.

validationRules.condition: recommendationState == validated_for_exact_context AND evidenceBasis not in [real_user_data, expert_review]
validationRules.message: Validated recommendations require real-user data or applicable expert review.

validationRules.condition: evidenceBasis == unsupported AND recommendationState not in [blocked_unsupported, needs_domain_evidence, needs_user_research, hypothesis_to_test]
validationRules.message: Unsupported evidence cannot create a ready, locally checked, user-supported, or validated recommendation.

validationRules.condition: deprecated alias appears in an output record before Phase 1
validationRules.message: Deprecated confidence aliases are tolerated only during Phase 0 migration.

validationRules.condition: deprecated alias appears in an output record after Phase 1
validationRules.message: Deprecated aliases must fail validation after Phase 1.

deprecatedAliases.note: The raw word remains valid only as an evidenceBasis value, not as an overloaded confidence label.
